_doc: cyber-watch config (kernel defaults). Playbook: agent/ops-agent/jobs/cyber-watch.md. This installation overlays it from agent/local/config/cyber-watch.json: `enabled` (off without it), `profile` (one or two sentences on who the user is, for the model), `stack` (the software the user runs, in words), `vendors[]` (the service providers that hold the user's money, credentials, data or devices) and `uninventoried` (devices the inventory cannot see). The weekly lane also proposes additions from new Plaid merchants into data/cyber-watch-state.json → learned_vendors (a model call decides, not a pattern). Tiers: 1 = money or credentials that unlock other things (bank, broker, password manager, a platform holding API secrets); 2 = an account holding personal data, a payment method or a device on the home network; 3 = ordinary consumer account, mention only on a major breach.
ignore_merchants: restaurants, cafes, bars, bakeries, grocery and convenience stores, salons, barbers, cleaners
one-off local shops, markets, parking, tolls, taxis, transit fares
government tax payments and individual people (Venmo/Zelle recipients, contractors)
